title: Hard-Rock Riff Practice Bed
purpose: Provide an original sparse 80s/hard-rock harmonic and rhythmic bed for palm-muted riff articulation, section changes, fills, and lead-over-riff practice without encoding the target guitar riff itself.
feel: straight hard-rock pulse; guitar supplies the muted riff and syncopation

tracks.name: Drums
tracks.instrument_intent: firm dry rock kit defining pulse and backbeat; avoid fills that compete with guitar riff articulation

tracks.name: Bass
tracks.instrument_intent: supportive electric bass reinforcing roots and fifths while leaving rhythmic detail to guitar

provenance.notes: Original hard-rock practice harmony. No commercial riff, melody, or song MIDI is reproduced.
